headline: Weathered Expanse Swings Warden as Mooring County Tallies Shift
war_summary: Three hours have redrawn the war's sharpest corner. Weathered Expanse, the costliest field of this campaign, now stands five Warden posts to four Colonial — against five Colonial to three Warden with one in ruin at the last edition — and its ledger of thirty-nine base actions in a day runs heaviest about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, the latest exchange logged before midnight. Mooring County's Warden count rose to eleven of twelve, though the fighting about Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut has since gone still. A fresh flare burned at Rotdust in Linn Mercy, the newest recorded action anywhere, while Nevish Line logged heavy losses around Grief Mother and Palantine Berm's Leiri Hermanni carried a six-event day. Stlican Shelf, contested six to three, has been quiet through the late hours. Callahan's Passage keeps its grim ledger — above eight thousand Colonial and six thousand Warden casualties in a day — without a post changing hands. Elsewhere the fronts rest; it is day 368, thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
